text.zh: 当您通过联系表单、邮件或下载资料与 VINNER 互动时，我们可能收集姓名、邮箱、公司名称、需求描述、下载记录以及基础访问日志信息。
text.en: When you contact VINNER through forms, email, or document downloads, we may collect your name, email address, company name, request details, download records, and basic access-log information.

heading.zh: 2. 我们如何使用这些信息

text.zh: 这些信息主要用于回复询盘、提供产品资料、安排样品或商务沟通、改进官网内容结构，以及评估哪些资源最有帮助。
text.en: We use this information to respond to inquiries, provide product information, arrange sampling or commercial communication, improve the site structure, and understand which resources are most useful.

text.zh: Cookie 是网站在您的设备上存储的小型文本文件，用于记录基础偏好、会话状态和分析信息。
text.en: Cookies are small text files stored on your device to remember basic preferences, session state, and analytics-related information.

text.zh: 本网站中的产品介绍、规格、应用说明和资源文件目前主要用于品牌展示、概念说明和初步商务沟通，不构成最终技术承诺或法律承诺。
text.en: The product descriptions, specifications, application notes, and resources on this website are primarily for brand presentation, concept framing, and initial commercial communication.

text.zh: 除另有说明外，本网站中的品牌名称、页面文案、结构设计、界面排版、图形元素和原创资料均归 VINNER 或其授权方所有。
text.en: Unless otherwise stated, the brand names, page copy, structural layout, interface design, graphic elements, and original materials on this website belong to VINNER or its licensors.
